summary: the density of liquid water at 0.1 MPa against temperature, by the IAPWS supplementary release

outputs.name: water_density_iapws_sr6
outputs.meaning: the density of liquid water at 0.1 MPa and the temperature given, the reciprocal of the specific volume

validity: liquid water at 0.1 MPa from 253.15 K to 383.15 K; the release states a relative uncertainty of 0.0001 % for the specific volume in the stable region. At standard atmospheric pressure the release adds a pressure term, its Eq. (6), which this skill does not apply

source.citation: IAPWS SR6-08(2011), Revised Supplementary Release on Properties of Liquid Water at 0.1 MPa, The International Association for the Properties of Water and Steam, Plzeň, September 2011
source.locus: Section 2.2, Eq. (2): v0 = (R * T_R / p0) * (a_5 + sum over i = 6..10 of a_i * alpha^n_i + sum over i = 5..10 of b_i * beta^m_i), with alpha and beta of Eq. (4) and the coefficients of Table 1; range in Eq. (5), uncertainty in Section 2.3; check values in Table 8 (density = 1 / v0)

note: Read from https://iapws.org/technical-guidance/release/LiquidWater.download on 2026-11-10T03:51:09Z (sha256:fda79dde9f441a90da755477c6533e23065e4f90c7f59a505f64c394d775bd45, 12 pages); its cover page allows publication in whole or in part with attribution to IAPWS. No copy of the document is in the repository. The three cases are the three density entries of Table 8, reproduced to the digits it prints.
